analysis: The trial succeeded with host validation macro HR@10=0.5212: Movies_and_TV 0.560, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.535, Electronics 0.325, and CDs_and_Vinyl 0.665. Allocated GPU time was 113.82 seconds. The single-user predictor agreement check passed, confirming agreement on the checked example. This success does not establish that batch-dependent TF32 differences caused the earlier failure; its underlying exception remains unknown. Electronics remains the weakest category.
code_summary: Trains a separate MultVAE for each of four routed datasets. Histories retain unique items with latest-occurrence recency weights, a 10-interaction half-life, and unit-L2 normalization. An EmbeddingBag encoder feeds a 256-unit hidden layer and 64-dimensional Gaussian latent representation; a tanh decoder produces item scores. Training uses binary multinomial reconstruction targets, input dropout 0.5, annealed KL capped at 0.2, Adam, and gradient clipping. Checkpoints are selected by validation HR@10 with NDCG tie-breaking and early stopping. The generated predictor shares preprocessing and architecture, uses the posterior mean, and scores supplied candidates. Artifacts and exception diagnostics are written beneath working/.
